project_info.name: SwiftProxy
project_info.compilation_status: Debug builds successfully, Release has minor async/await issues
project_info.test_status: Tests fail due to incorrect module imports

tasks.title: Fix test module imports
tasks.description: All test files are importing '@testable import SwiftProxy' but the module is named 'SwiftProxyCore' in Package.swift. This blocks all testing.
tasks.technical_details: Replace '@testable import SwiftProxy' with '@testable import SwiftProxyCore' in all test files
tasks.completion_criteria: Tests can compile and start running

tasks.title: Add 'make app' target to Makefile
tasks.description: CLAUDE.md references 'make app' as the primary build command but it doesn't exist. This is critical for following the project's documented workflow.
tasks.technical_details: Create an 'app' target that builds release version and creates SwiftProxy.app bundle with Info.plist and code signing
tasks.completion_criteria: 'make app' command creates a runnable SwiftProxy.app bundle

tasks.title: Fix NotificationManager async/await issues
tasks.description: Release build fails with 'no async operations occur within await expression' errors for NotificationManager methods
tasks.technical_details: Either make NotificationManager methods truly async or remove unnecessary await keywords

tasks.title: Complete SSLHandler implementation
tasks.description: SSLHandler has platform API issues and incomplete certificate validation logic. This is needed for HTTPS proxying.
tasks.technical_details: Fix sec_trust_copy_certificate_chain API calls, fix CFString conversions, complete certificate validation, add TLS 1.3 support with 1.2 fallback
tasks.completion_criteria: SSLHandler compiles and provides full TLS/SSL support

tasks.title: Fix PacketHandler initializer visibility
tasks.description: PacketHandler initializer is not public, preventing usage from other modules
tasks.technical_details: Make initializer public, add packet buffering logic, implement traffic shaping
tasks.completion_criteria: PacketHandler can be instantiated and used for packet processing

tasks.title: Implement PerformanceOptimizations module
tasks.description: TrafficInterceptor and other components depend on PerformanceOptimizations which doesn't exist
tasks.technical_details: Implement RateLimiter with token bucket algorithm, add memory pool management, implement performance monitoring utilities
tasks.completion_criteria: PerformanceOptimizations module provides rate limiting and monitoring capabilities

tasks.title: Complete Keychain integration
tasks.description: Multiple TODOs for Keychain support in ConfigurationService. Needed for secure credential storage.
tasks.technical_details: Create cross-platform Keychain protocol abstraction, implement password storage/retrieval/deletion at lines 50, 112, 157, 236, 335
tasks.completion_criteria: Passwords are securely stored in Keychain instead of UserDefaults

tasks.title: Fix all unit test implementations
tasks.description: Once imports are fixed, tests need to be verified and fixed for actual functionality
tasks.technical_details: Fix test assertions, mock dependencies, ensure >80% code coverage
tasks.completion_criteria: All unit tests pass with >80% code coverage

tasks.title: Implement Main UI missing features
tasks.description: SwiftProxyApp has TODOs for new configuration window, quick status popover, and menu toggle
tasks.technical_details: Implement 'Show new configuration window' (line 61), 'Show quick status popover' (line 152), 'Toggle proxy state' menu action (line 156)
tasks.completion_criteria: All main UI features are functional and accessible from menu bar

tasks.title: Implement Statistics Export functionality
tasks.description: StatisticsView has TODO for CSV/JSON export functionality
tasks.technical_details: Implement CSV export (line 385), add JSON export, date range selection, filtering options
tasks.completion_criteria: Users can export statistics data in CSV and JSON formats

tasks.title: Complete Settings View features
tasks.description: SettingsView has multiple TODOs for rule editor, import/export, logs management
tasks.technical_details: Implement rule editor UI (line 150), rule import (line 387), logs directory (line 394), clear logs (line 407), clear cache (line 413), reset settings (line 430)

tasks.title: Add PAC support and proxy chains
tasks.description: Advanced proxy features for enterprise use cases
tasks.technical_details: Implement PAC (Proxy Auto-Config) support, add proxy chain support, implement load balancing
tasks.completion_criteria: PAC files can be loaded and proxy chains work

tasks.title: Enhance Rule Engine
tasks.description: Add GeoIP, user agent, and time-based rules
tasks.technical_details: Add GeoIP rule matching, implement user agent matching, add time-based conditional rules

tasks.title: Integration and Performance Tests
tasks.description: Add comprehensive integration and performance test suites
tasks.technical_details: Test ProxyServer + ConnectionPool, test all proxy flows, benchmark performance, test connection pool hit rate (target >80%)
tasks.completion_criteria: Integration tests pass, performance benchmarks meet targets

tasks.title: System Integration with Network Extension
tasks.description: Add system-wide proxy support via Network Extension
tasks.technical_details: Requires Apple Developer Program enrollment, implement Network Extension for system-wide proxying
tasks.completion_criteria: System-wide proxy works without manual configuration

tasks.title: Add HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 support
tasks.description: Modern protocol support for better performance
tasks.technical_details: Implement HTTP/2 multiplexing, add HTTP/3/QUIC support
tasks.completion_criteria: HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 protocols are functional

tasks.title: Documentation and User Guides
tasks.technical_details: Write user guide, API documentation, troubleshooting guide, video tutorials

immediate_actions: Fix test imports to unblock testing
Add 'make app' target for documented workflow
Fix NotificationManager async issues for release builds
